definitions.servo_command_deg: The labelled absolute servo g angle used during capture.
definitions.optical_offset_deg: Signed camera-ray angle of the red marker centre in the arm motion plane; positive is downward in the image.
definitions.inferred_servo_angle_deg: The g-equivalent servo angle inferred from an image through the inverse lookup table; this is not direct encoder telemetry.

runtime_anchor.detector: HSV red-circle detector during calibration; external target detector during automatic operation
runtime_anchor.requirement: The red marker centre represented the gripper centre during calibration. The marker may be removed in automatic mode: detect the external target centre and invert this table to command the gripper onto the same ray. Keep the marker only when visually inferring the current servo angle with run_servo_angle_monitor.py.

mechanical_transmission.note: Do not multiply the gear ratio into this empirical lookup again.

fit.method: Mean of per-node median red-marker bearings from two independent recordings; both travel directions are included except the -100 degree turnaround node.
fit.absolute_accuracy_note: These values measure camera-derived repeatability, not externally traceable absolute angle accuracy.

source.exclusion_reason: The calibrated range remains -100 to -35 degrees; -30 degrees was not recorded because the marker leaves the useful image region.
source.recalibration_reason: The mechanism exceeded its intended travel limit, so the servo-command to optical-angle relation was re-measured after the mechanical state was restored.
